conversationalSummary.text: TODAY there doesn’t look like a reliable window for bodyboarding, mainly because the wind setup for Rey Cortiço doesn’t fit and the forecast/cam consistency is pretty poor. The tide is low and dropping, but on this kind of day it probably won’t be enough to make up for the cross-onshore wind. I’d check Surfline and MEO Beachcam before bothering to head out, and if they don’t look clearly cleaner than expected, I’d save the drive.

best.explanation: Rey Cortiço looks like a small north coast window for Rare window, Low confidence: 0.3-0.6 m, 36 kJ, 11 s period, lully 7/100, and wind is the main risk.  An open beach break where the sandbanks decide everything; this is best for quiet, punchy peaks when Lagide is too small; 10-13s at low tide can still work well on Belgas, so checking exposed beaches makes sense.  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; wind angle is poor for this spot.
best.shortExplanation: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for after work (17:00 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.
warnings: wind angle is poor for this spot
